shortDescription: Management of Cohesity UDA Protection Groups

options.name: alert_targets
options.description: Specifies list of alert target objects to receive an alert For every object, User need to specify email address, language and recepient type. email_address - Specifies an email address to receive an alert language - Specifies the language of the delivery target. Default value is 'en-us'. choices - en-us, ja-jp, zh-cn recipient_type - Specifies the recipient type of email recipient. Default value is 'kTo'. choices - To, Cc

options.name: alerting_policy
options.description: Specifies a policy for alerting users of the status of a Protection Group. Default value is Success

options.name: cancel_active
options.description: Specifies if Current Running Backup Group should be canceled.  If False, active groups will not be stopped and a failure will be raised. Optional and only valid when I(state=stopped)

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats username@AD.domain.com AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant Domain/username (Will be deprecated in future)

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: concurrency
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent IO Streams that will be created to exchange data with the cluster.

options.name: delete_backups
options.description: Specifies if Snapshots generated by the Protection Group should also be deleted when the Group is deleted. Optional and only valid when I(state=absent)

options.name: description
options.description: Optional Description to assign to the Protection Group

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Ip address of the Uda host.

options.name: environment
options.description: Specifies the environment type of the group.

options.name: full_backup_args
options.description: Specifies the custom arguments to be supplied to the full backup script when a full backup is enabled in the policy.

options.name: incr_backup_args
options.description: Specifies the custom arguments to be supplied to the incremental backup script when an incremental backup is enabled in the policy.

options.name: is_paused
options.description: Switch determines whether the newly created job run should be enabled or not.

options.name: log_backup_args
options.description: Specifies the custom arguments to be supplied to the log backup script when a log backup is enabled in the policy.

options.name: mounts
options.description: Specifies the maximum number of view mounts per host.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to assign to the Protection Group

options.name: objects
options.description: Defines the list of objects to be protected.

options.name: ondemand_run_type
options.description: Specifies the type of OnDemand Backup.

options.name: protection_policy
options.description: Valid policy name or ID for andexisting Protection Policy to be assigned to the group. Required when I(state=present).

options.name: start_time
options.description: Specifies the registered start time for the Protection Group.  Format must be 24hr time in either HHMM or HH:MM style. If not configured then the Cluster will automatically select a time.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Protection Group

options.name: storage_domain
options.description: Existing Storage Domain to which the Protection Group will be associated. Required when I(state=present).

options.name: time_zone
options.description: Specifies the timezone to use when calculating time for this Protection Group such as the Group start time.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled or not.
